hints.title: Share the work between related words
hints.body: Words such as `car`, `cart`, and `cargo` share the same opening characters. Storing them in one character-by-character structure avoids repeating those characters.

hints.title: Two facts per node
hints.body: Each node needs a way to reach child nodes keyed by character, plus a flag saying whether a complete word ends there. The flag is what separates an exact search from a prefix query.

hints.title: Walk, then inspect
hints.body: For every query, follow the characters from the root. If a character edge is missing, the answer is `false` immediately. Otherwise `startsWith` answers `true` once the whole prefix was consumed, while `search` additionally needs the terminal flag at the final node.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
nodes = [ empty child map ], terminal = [false]

insert(word):
    node = 0
    for ch in word:
        if ch not in nodes[node]: create a new node
        node = nodes[node][ch]
    terminal[node] = true

find(word):
    node = 0
    for ch in word:
        if ch not in nodes[node]: return -1
        node = nodes[node][ch]
    return node

search(word):
    node = find(word)
    return node >= 0 and terminal[node]

startsWith(prefix):
    return find(prefix) >= 0
```
